cl.x: Provide Sika® Anchor-300 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Sika® Anchor-300 is a hard PVC anchor shaft in grey colour combined with Sikaplan® PVC waterproofing membrane flange in yellow colour.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Anchor-300 is used in double-shell tunnel constructions in combination with waterproofing sheet membranes on base of PVC-p to temporary fix the reinforcement of the inner lining to the outer shell, until the secondary concrete or shotcrete lining is cured and self-supporting.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
cl.x: The substrate conditions are as defined for the waterproofing membrane system which is to be combined with the Sika® Anchor-300.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

s: Thickness: Membrane: 2.0 mm

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > Installation method
cl.x: 1. Cut out a small section of the waterproofing system or drill through it directly 2. Drill a hole into the substrate 3. Clean the drill hole with high pressure water jet 4. Clean the drill hole with compressed air 5. Inject Sikadur® -31 or Sika® AnchorFix®-2, or use anchor capsule 6. Install Sika® Anchor-300 7. Weld against Sikaplan® PVC membrane 8. Install steel anchor for temporary fixing of rebar cage

s: Sika® is not responsible for the permissible anchor forces or the related loading calculations.
Preliminary pull-out tests are mandatory.
Installation works must only be carried out by Sika® trained contractors.
The membrane is not UV stabilized and cannot be installed on structures permanently exposed to sunlight and weathering.

cl.x: Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
